vBRIEFInfo.description: Auto-synthesized minimal plan for PAN-2405: feat(dashboard): 'Restart agents with current config' header control — explicit opt-in re-staffing; resume keeps original model by design

plan.title: feat(dashboard): 'Restart agents with current config' header control — explicit opt-in re-staffing; resume keeps original model by design
plan.author: overdeck/auto-start

narratives.Problem:
## Operator intent (2026-07-06)

> If the dashboard restarts agents that were configured with one model, and I then change configuration, they should still restart with the model they started with — that is the correct behavior. But we need a mechanism to restart all agents with the new model if I want to. This needs to be a button — maybe up by the freeze / stop-all / memory display area of the dashboard.

## Current behavior (correct, keep it)

Resume/auto-restart reuses the agent's recorded model + harness from its runtime state — `resumeAgent` logs `harness=unchanged` and resumes the recorded session. A config change never silently re-staffs an existing agent. This issue does NOT change that default; it adds the explicit opt-in path.

## Requirements

- FR-1: A header control near the existing Deacon-freeze / stop-all / memory chips: **"Restart with current config"**.
- FR-2: Clicking opens a confirm dialog listing every affected agent as a row: id, issue, current model/harness → the model/harness it would get from CURRENT config (roles + tier table via `resolveStaffing`). Rows where nothing would change are shown but marked "unchanged".
- FR-3: Operator can deselect rows; confirm restarts the selected agents: graceful stop → fresh spawn through the normal staffing resolvers (NOT session resume — a model/harness change requires a fresh session, per the model-change ⇒ fresh-session rule).
- FR-4: Per-agent scope too: the same action on a single agent from the issue cockpit's crew/agents lane context menu.
- FR-5: Never touches paused or troubled agents (their gates stand); never touches conversations.
- FR-6: The restart goes through existing lifecycle doors (stop + spawn) — no new state plane; each restart logged to the agent's lifecycle log with before→after staffing.

## Non-requirements

- No automatic re-staffing on config save (explicitly rejected — the operator may NOT want it).

## Notes

- Fresh spawn must preserve the agent's work context (workspace, beads, continue state) — same contract as a normal fresh start after `pan kill`.
- Placement: the header status-chip cluster (Deacon frozen · N agents · Stop all · N stopped · memory).
